_comment: v0.2.97 R12 SSOT-1 — the `decide` contract: ONE verdict for every surface, driven by
tests/test_v0297_runtime_decide.py (Python: vco_lib.runtime_reconcile.decide). This is the
fixture lane SSOT-2 points the Rust surfaces at: each case is a COMPLETE fake machine +
install root, and `expect` is a SUBSET match on the schema-1 JSON `decide --json` prints
(`<key>_contains` entries are substring asserts on string fields).
Case shape:
mode/purpose   the CLI flags ('read-only' writes nothing; 'install' may re-record).
record         state/install/runtime.txt ('null' = no record).
confirmed      state/install/runtime.confirmed ('null' = none).
env_pin        VCT_CONTAINER_RUNTIME ('null' = unset).
infra_env      infrastructure/.env text; '{DATA}' placeholders resolve to a temp dir.
folders        directories to create under that temp dir; 'entries' become files.
runtimes       per runtime: on_path / version_ok / daemon_ok (the `info` probe) /
compose_subcommand (`<rt> compose version` exits 0) / standalone
(`<rt>-compose` on PATH), the listings ps_a (`ps -a --format {{.Names}}`),
ps (`ps --format {{.Names}}`, the RUNNING ones), volume_ls, the full
container IDs ps_a_ids (`ps -a --no-trunc --format {{.ID}}`) and the raw
version_out text. A runtime absent from the map is not installed.
HOW RUST REPRODUCES A CASE (SSOT-2): build a temp install root with the record/confirmed/
infrastructure/.env files ({DATA} resolved), put executable stub scripts named `podman` /
`docker` on a PATH handed to the child (HOME pointed at an empty temp dir so the compose
standalone leg finds nothing), and have each stub answer the argv grammar above — `version`
prints version_out and exits version_ok, `info` exits daemon_ok, `compose version` exits
compose_subcommand, `ps -a --format {{.Names}}` prints ps_a, `ps --format {{.Names}}` prints
ps, `ps -a --no-trunc --format {{.ID}}` prints ps_a_ids, `volume ls --format {{.Name}}`
prints volume_ls — then run `python -m vco_lib.runtime_reconcile decide --json --root <root>
[--mode m] [--purpose p]` with VCT_CONTAINER_RUNTIME set per env_pin, parse the JSON and
apply the same subset match. Exit code 0 = resolved, 3 = refused (absent or unknown).

cases.name: auto_no_record
cases._why: No pin anywhere: auto-detection picks the first usable candidate.

cases.name: env_pin_honored
cases._why: VCT_CONTAINER_RUNTIME is honoured when the pinned runtime answers.

cases.name: env_pin_refused
cases._why: An env pin for a runtime that is not installed is REFUSED, never swapped; the refusal names the knob and the repin target.

cases.name: record_kept
cases._why: The recorded runtime answers and nothing suggests a switch: the record stands.

cases.name: confirmed_missing_refuses
cases._why: runtime.confirmed matches the record: only the user switches, so the missing runtime is refused with the shared `confirmed` wording.

cases.name: stale_switches_on_running
cases._why: Case (a) on positive evidence: the recorded docker is gone, podman RUNS VCO's containers — every surface answers podman, the record is reconciled read-only.

cases.name: stale_no_data_read_only_refuses
cases._why: R9 H1: 'no VCO data anywhere' is install's decision alone — read-only refuses with `no_data`.

cases.name: stale_no_data_install_rewrites
cases._why: Same machine at install: the record IS re-recorded (nothing is stranded), so the post-verdict pin already reads podman.

cases.name: bind_leftover_volume_kept
cases._why: R10 J2: the folder is the data; a leftover volume under the other runtime is not evidence about it — the record stands.

cases.name: all_bind_nothing_read_only_refuses
cases._why: R12 M1: every service is a folder and NOTHING of VCO's is under podman — absence is not evidence, so read-only refuses with `no_data` (install still switches).

cases.name: all_bind_stopped_switches
cases._why: R12 M1's positive leg: stopped VCO containers under podman ARE evidence it serves the stack, so the switch goes through even read-only.

cases.name: same_engine_version_text
cases._why: R12 M7: docker's `version` output names podman (a podman-docker shim) — one engine under two names, so 'data under both' collapses and the record is KEPT.

docker.version_out: docker version 24.0 (emulates the docker CLI using podman)

cases.name: same_engine_id_intersection
cases._why: R12 M7, second leg: clean version outputs, but both listings answer the same FULL container ID — one engine read twice.

cases.name: bind_stopped_read_only_data_under_both
cases._why: R11 L2 (ii), case (a): stopped VCO containers under the other runtime beside the data folder — read-only refuses with `data_under_both` and the bind rationale (never 'SEPARATE named volumes').

refusal_contains: either runtime could serve that folder

cases.name: module_purpose_no_compose
cases._why: The module plane drives single containers: compose is not probed and the compose fields are null.

cases.name: two_engines_data_under_both
cases._why: The M7 control: two genuinely distinct engines (clean versions, disjoint IDs) both holding VCO containers stay DATA_UNDER_BOTH.

cases.name: stale_other_unusable_refuses
cases._why: R12bis F3(a): the recorded docker is gone AND podman is unusable (installed, daemon down) — the other_not_usable decline; nothing is driven, the refusal names both runtimes.

cases.name: confirmed_disagrees_record_switch_lands_on_confirmed
cases._why: R12bis F3(b): runtime.confirmed (podman) disagrees with the record (docker) — a switch target is always _other(record), so a switch can only ever land ON the confirmed runtime, never away from one; the data being under podman, the stale-record switch proceeds.

cases.name: bind_running_both_one_engine_kept
cases._why: R12bis F3(c): the BIND arm's VERDICT_BOTH shape (~the running_both + here_running reconcile arm): the folder holds VCO's data, both runtimes RUN VCO containers — a podman-docker shim collapses it to KEPT, same_engine, no data_under_both.

docker.version_out: docker version 24.0 (emulates the docker CLI using podman)
